shortDescription: Member check-in result view entry point.
fullDescription: Renders the member check-in result screen on the home route and passes the current view state into the shared member check-in result component. Supports the planned check-in-success, payment-method-invalid, and membership-cancelled states through the shared component contract.

shortDescription: Reusable gym member check-in result screen component.
fullDescription: Displays the gym member check-in result experience with a top bar, member number search control, hero status banner, member details, amenities grid, and status footer. Accepts serializable props for state, member data, defaultMemberNumber, and onSearch so the same component can render check-in-success, payment-method-invalid, and membership-cancelled variants while keeping the search input and action immediately usable.
